Cluster PDF font sizes into heading levels and retain bounding boxes

```go title="Go"
package main

import (
	"fmt"
	xberg "github.com/xberg-io/xberg/packages/go"
)

func ptr[T any](value T) *T { return &value }
func main() {
	input := xberg.ExtractInput{
		Kind:     ptr(xberg.ExtractInputKindURI),
		URI:      ptr(`https://example.com/pdf/embedded_images_tables.pdf`),
		MimeType: ptr(`application/pdf`),
	}
	config := xberg.ExtractionConfig{
		PdfOptions: &xberg.PdfConfig{
		ExtractMetadata: ptr(true),
		Hierarchy:       &xberg.HierarchyConfig{
		Enabled:     ptr(true),
		KClusters:   ptr(uint(6)),
		IncludeBbox: ptr(true),
	},
	},
	}
	result, err := xberg.Extract(input, config)
	if err != nil {
		panic(err)
	}
	fmt.Printf("%+v\n", result.Results[0].Pages)
}
```
